'''The Prism''', also called the '''Ghost Prison''', was a secret [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] whose existence was only known to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] and had been constructed during the [[Second Great Schism]]. The prison was used to house incredibly dangerous criminals during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was located in the [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]] of the [[Diab 6|sixth moon]] of [[Diab]] in the [[Diab system/Legends|Diab system]], a three day trip from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], even with a presumably fast [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison. The prison was built to be inescapable and self-sustaining, and had a skeleton crew of 100 security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and one [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Master [[Skein]]. The prison also boasted a top medical facility.

==History==
The prison was visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]], and then after the war by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Laurita Tohm]], and [[Trachta]] while finding a place to regroup and treat the grievously-injured [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The prison housed 208 prisoners by then, half of whom had been apprehended by Anakin Skywalker and [[Unidentified Dark Jedi Padawan|one]] who had disfigured Trachta. Darth Vader, alongside Trachta and valedictorian Laurita Tohm, were forced to locate the facility after a [[Ghost Prison incident|military coup]] severely injured Emperor Palpatine. Tohm approached Vader with the idea that releasing the prisoners would provide them with an army, but Vader amended the idea, believing that the prisoners should battle one another for the right to join the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. Of the 207 prisoners released, only thirty-three of them survived in fighting condition.
